axes.label: Execution
axes.description: Plan, build, and deliver work with increasing scope and independence.

levels.summary: Write code with assistance and fix bugs identified by others.
Deliver feature level code and contribute to milestones and production fixes.
Implement projects independently, cover changes with tests, and communicate delivery status.
Identify project issues, plan milestones, and deliver consistently across a team.
Lead complex initiatives across teams and resolve the most consequential delivery problems.
Align delivery of major technical efforts with company goals and industry impact.

axes.label: Engineering Best Practices
axes.description: Improve quality, architecture, operations, and the engineering system around the work.

levels.summary: Learn and follow team coding, testing, and architecture practices.
Apply team practices in code, tests, infrastructure, and approved designs.
Encourage sound practices in reviews and document new technical debt.
Identify process and architecture improvements and contribute proposals to review.
Create reusable tools and playbooks while improving practices across adjacent teams.
Steer architecture and spread effective engineering practices across the organization.

axes.label: Customer Focus
axes.description: Connect engineering choices to customer needs and measurable business outcomes.

levels.summary: Learn how assigned work connects to customer problems and service ownership.
Ship features that solve customer problems and communicate on call status.
Use customer feedback and analytics to shape feature delivery.
Ask why a feature matters and proactively respond to stakeholder needs.
Clarify product roadmaps and translate customer needs into work across teams.
Shape organization wide technical direction around significant customer and business outcomes.

axes.label: Leadership
axes.description: Help others make decisions, grow, and deliver together without requiring management authority.

levels.summary: Understand team roles, ask useful questions, and own individual commitments.
Demonstrate accountability for individual work and suggest improvements.
Own project results, lead feature discussions, and surface tradeoffs.
Model team accountability, lead technical choices, and help others unblock work.
Influence decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and create leverage for other contributors.
Lead technical direction across the engineering organization and develop its culture.

axes.label: Vision and Strategy
axes.description: See the longer horizon, connect work to goals, and guide technical choices.

levels.summary: Seek to understand the team's vision and strategy.
Follow team strategy and learn the department's direction.
Design a complete feature area and test its technical feasibility.
Identify gaps in team strategy and propose a sound path forward.
Contribute to a long term technology roadmap across teams and manage technical debt deliberately.
Provide technical vision and steer the company's overall architecture.
